# phron_storage_key (Resource)

A Storage Access Key for the S3 endpoint. The secret is returned by the API once, at creation, and is stored in the Terraform state: protect the state accordingly. Every attribute forces a new key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "phron_storage_key" "writer" {
  name         = "log-writer"
  preset       = "read_write_objects"
  bucket_names = [phron_storage_bucket.logs.full_name]
  location     = "fsn1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A name for the key.
- `preset` (String) The permission preset: "full", "read_write_objects" or "read_only_objects".

### Optional

- `bucket_names` (Set of String) Full names of the buckets the key may reach. Unset: every bucket.
- `expires_at` (String) When the key expires, as an RFC 3339 timestamp. Unset: never.
- `location` (String) The Location id of the storage the key is for, when the Workspace has storage in more than one.
- `workspace_id` (String) The Workspace of the storage. Empty means the Organization's default Workspace.

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String) The S3 access key id.
- `created_by` (String) The member who created the key.
- `id` (String) The key id.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) The S3 secret access key. Readable only at creation; kept in the state.
- `status` (String) active, suspended or expired.
